decisive_items: a 1.5-cm long, solid structure with lobular architecture
a lobulated retroareolar mass approximately 1.5 cm in diameter
response.rationale: New focal solid lobulated mass without microcalcifications (BIRADS III) in a young male favors a benign fibroadenoma over malignancy; gynecomastia is diffuse and already known, not a new discrete mass.

rejected.why: BIRADS III and absence of microcalcifications make breast cancer unlikely in this young male.
Gynecomastia is a diffuse process and already documented; the new focal mass is distinct.
Too nonspecific; the imaging pattern is more consistent with a specific benign tumor.
